Summary: The "405B" in LLaMA 3.1 405B stands for 405 billion parameters, making it one of the largest language models available today. It requires approximately 2 terabytes (TB) of storage for the model weights in its full precision (FP32 format) and is recognized as the largest publicly available large language model at the time of its release. The model is capable of generating highly detailed and accurate text, understanding complex contexts, and performing sophisticated natural language tasks. It is also noted for its exceptional capabilities in areas such as general knowledge, synthetic data generation, advanced reasoning, contextual understanding, long-form text, multilingual translation, coding, math, and tool use.
